name: Gnedenko: Fréchet domain of attraction
statement:
CumulativeDistributionFunction.isInMDAFrechet_iff (F : CumulativeDistributionFunction) {α : ℝ}
  (hα : 0 < α) :
  F.IsInMDAFrechet hα ↔
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun x => 1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction x) (-α)
scope_note: Both directions. Eventual positivity inside regular variation encodes x_F = infinity. Explicit norming constants are not in the statement.

name: Gnedenko: Weibull domain of attraction
statement:
CumulativeDistributionFunction.isInMDAWeibull_iff (F : CumulativeDistributionFunction) {α : ℝ}
  (hα : 0 < α) :
  F.IsInMDAWeibull hα ↔
    ∃ xF,
      ↑F.toStieltjesFunction xF = 1 ∧
        (∀ x < xF, ↑F.toStieltjesFunction x < 1) ∧
          ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun t => 1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction (xF - t⁻¹))
            (-α)
scope_note: Both directions, with x_F exactly the right endpoint. Explicit norming constants are not in the statement.

name: De Haan: Gumbel domain of attraction
statement:
CumulativeDistributionFunction.isInMDAGumbel_iff (F : CumulativeDistributionFunction) :
  F.IsInMDAGumbel ↔
    ((∀ (x : ℝ), ↑F.toStieltjesFunction x < 1) ∧
        ∃ f,
          (∀ᶠ (t : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < f t) ∧
            ∀ (x : ℝ),
              Filter.Tendsto
                (fun t =>
                  (1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction (t + x * f t)) / (1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction t))
                Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.exp (-x)))) ∨
      ∃ xF,
        (∀ x < xF, ↑F.toStieltjesFunction x < 1) ∧
          ↑F.toStieltjesFunction xF = 1 ∧
            ∃ f,
              (∀ᶠ (t : ℝ) in nhdsWithin xF (Set.Iio xF), 0 < f t) ∧
                ∀ (x : ℝ),
                  Filter.Tendsto
                    (fun t =>
                      (1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction (t + x * f t)) / (1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction t))
                    (nhdsWithin xF (Set.Iio xF)) (nhds (Real.exp (-x)))
scope_note: Both directions, x_F finite or infinite, one auxiliary function for all x. Stated as a disjunction of the two endpoint cases.

name: Von Mises condition for the Fréchet domain
statement:
CumulativeDistributionFunction.isInMDAFrechet_of_vonMises (F : CumulativeDistributionFunction)
  {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) {z : ℝ} {F₁ : ℝ → ℝ}
  (h1 : ∀ x > z, HasDerivAt (↑F.toStieltjesFunction) (F₁ x) x)
  (hvm :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x => x * F₁ x / (1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction x)) Filter.atTop (nhds α)) :
  F.IsInMDAFrechet hα
scope_note: A derivative of F near infinity instead of a density; positivity of the derivative is not assumed.

name: Von Mises condition for the Weibull domain
statement:
CumulativeDistributionFunction.isInMDAWeibull_of_vonMises (F : CumulativeDistributionFunction)
  {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) {z xF : ℝ} (hz : z < xF) {F₁ : ℝ → ℝ}
  (h1 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo z xF, HasDerivAt (↑F.toStieltjesFunction) (F₁ x) x)
  (hvm :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (xF - x) * F₁ x / (1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction x))
      (nhdsWithin xF (Set.Iio xF)) (nhds α)) :
  F.IsInMDAWeibull hα
scope_note: A derivative of F near x_F instead of a density; F(x_F) = 1 is derived.

name: Von Mises condition for the Gumbel domain, infinite endpoint
statement:
CumulativeDistributionFunction.isInMDAGumbel_of_vonMises (F : CumulativeDistributionFunction)
  {z : ℝ} {F₁ F₂ : ℝ → ℝ} (h1 : ∀ x > z, HasDerivAt (↑F.toStieltjesFunction) (F₁ x) x)
  (h2 : ∀ x > z, HasDerivAt F₁ (F₂ x) x) (hpos : ∀ x > z, 0 < F₁ x)
  (hvm :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction t) * F₂ t / F₁ t ^ 2) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (-1))) :
  F.IsInMDAGumbel
scope_note: x_F = infinity only: the cited theorem also covers finite x_F, which is the separate entry von-mises-gumbel-finite. Together they give the book's result.

name: Von Mises condition for the Gumbel domain, finite endpoint
statement:
CumulativeDistributionFunction.isInMDAGumbel_of_vonMises_nhdsLT (F : CumulativeDistributionFunction)
  {z xF : ℝ} (hz : z < xF) {F₁ F₂ : ℝ → ℝ}
  (h1 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo z xF, HasDerivAt (↑F.toStieltjesFunction) (F₁ x) x)
  (h2 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo z xF, HasDerivAt F₁ (F₂ x) x) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo z xF, 0 < F₁ x)
  (hF1 : Filter.Tendsto (↑F.toStieltjesFunction) (nhdsWithin xF (Set.Iio xF)) (nhds 1))
  (hvm :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (1 - ↑F.toStieltjesFunction t) * F₂ t / F₁ t ^ 2)
      (nhdsWithin xF (Set.Iio xF)) (nhds (-1))) :
  F.IsInMDAGumbel
scope_note: x_F finite only, with F -> 1 at x_F as an explicit hypothesis (needed: atom-von-mises-counterexample). The infinite endpoint is the separate entry von-mises-gumbel-infinite.

name: The exponential law is in the Gumbel domain
scope_note: An example; the standard exponential law only.

name: A finite-endpoint law in the Gumbel domain
Quantile form of the domain of attraction condition
statement:
CumulativeDistributionFunction.isInMDAGEV_iff_exists_isExtendedRegularlyVarying_tailQuantile
  (F : CumulativeDistributionFunction) (γ : ℝ) :
  F.IsInMDAGEV γ ↔ ∃ a, ExtremeValueTheory.IsExtendedRegularlyVarying F.tailQuantile γ a
scope_note: Both directions, every extreme value index; the auxiliary function is existential.
